verdict.rationale: Chargebee documents an asynchronous Export API that returns a download URL to a zip/pdf of exported data, and a general REST API that returns JSON, so bulk data export is supported. The evidence does not say which resources are covered, and usage events are documented only for ingestion. Nothing addresses porting stored payment methods to another provider. Missing for 10: confirmation that subscriptions, invoices, and usage records are each exportable; any payment-method/card-vault portability to another processor; independent or hands-on corroboration of a full exit migration.
